newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index ends lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index ends lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed 0.86 percent lower with a higher volume traded, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 481.77 points, down from 485.95 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 1.82 million dinars against 1.20 million over the previous session.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia was up 0.2 dinar to 44.2 dinars. Airline Tunis Air rose 0.2 dinar to 23.7 with 5,592 shares exchanged.
BTEI bank advanced 0.14 dinar to 22.44 dinars.

Banque de Tunisie dropped 2.26 dinar to 74.14 dinars. Amen Bank fell 1.98 dinar to 31.8. UBCI bank was down 1.42 dinar to 46.38 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie slid 0.82 dinar to 32.02. Societe Tunisienne de Banque edged 0.48 dinar lower to 15.51 dinars with 13,500 shares changing hands.

Drinks bottler SFBT slid two dinars to 87 dinars with only 50 shares changing hands. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was down 0.24 dinar to 11.16 dinars. Placement de Tunisie declined 0.3 dinar to 12 dinars. Investment fund Tuninvest -SICAF was down 0.2 dinar to 12 dinars with 10,275 shares changing hands.
